authorization: User requested sequential execution: five new parents, two continuations, three schedules; common-8k switch experiment; then fresh-parent cost-inclusive comparison. Later stages depend on preceding scientific gates and frozen execution specifications.
objective: final equal-weight mean success over four tasks

stage1.parent_retention: reference action evaluated once; reported separately from the primary three-schedule choice
primary_estimands: cross-continuation and cross-case-half parent-informed choice gain vs prespecified BP and leave-parent-out fixed choice
secondary_estimands: held-out choice regret within the three measured methods

gate.type: exploratory resource decision, not a significance test or proof of absence
gate.repeatable_margin_score: Entire O100 equal-weight macro success for each parent and continuation, not either half
gate.leave_one_parent_out_definition: Remove that parent entirely, rerun parent-informed choices and leave-target-parent-out fixed-method selection within the remaining four parents, then recompute gains. BP remains prespecified.
gate.deleting_precomputed_parent_gains: Secondary descriptive sensitivity only; not the progression gate

stage1.fixed_selection: For each target parent and selection half, equally average both continuations of each other parent, then equally average those parent means; ties BP, alternate4k, mixture
stage1.aggregation: Four crossed scores per parent (2 continuation directions x 2 half directions), then equal-weight parents; not 20 independent observations
stage1.checkpoint36_cost: 30 extra full snapshots; environment steps and intermediate evaluation episodes added: zero
stage1.partial_block_rule: Use the exact existing generated schedule prefix. No quota rebalancing, reshuffling, phase restart or RNG reset at 36k or another budget endpoint.
stage1.pretraining_source_reuse: Completed v42 banks and full pretraining states reused with hash-verified job lineage; an in-flight worker finishes its job before handoff

stage2.parents: stage1 development parents, never called independent confirmation
stage2.fixed_method: highest stage1 grand mean among three fixed schedules, deterministic tie priority
stage2.alternative: highest stage1 grand mean among the remaining two schedules, same tie priority

score.counts: s_t in {0,1,2}: number of any-success episodes among two fixed-500-step cases for task t
score.interpretation: One preselected B-specific candidate signal, not an established factor; definition stays fixed even if F* is not BP focus

stage2.rule_family: 26 explicitly frozen candidates: two constant actions plus twelve attainable-score boundaries in each direction
stage2.validation: Leave whole original parent out for threshold fitting and scoring, conditional on F*/A* and the development-state set selected using all stage1 parents

gate.type: exploratory conditional-development investment gate; not independent full-pipeline confirmation
gate.repeatable_preferences: At least one parent with keep minus switch >=2pp at both distinct 8k states, and another with switch minus keep >=2pp, using entire O100 at 28k suffix.
gate.heldout_information_gain: LOPO rule mean must be positive against both always_keep and always_switch
gate.robustness: Both gains remain positive under full parent-removal refitting
gate.constant_rule_result: If always-switch is sufficient, report a fixed-switch schedule; do not claim state information value

stage2.stage3_full_sample_size: freeze from stage2 variability and target precision before new-parent outcomes; no automatic expansion
stage2.repeatability_unit: Two different 8k states from each original parent, each with one paired keep/switch future; not repeated future draws from one identical state
stage2.limitation: Stage1 support need not involve the globally top-two F*/A* pair. A negative stage2 result is limited to this pair and this diagnostic/rule family.
stage2.partial_block_rule: Keep the generated task order and terminate after exactly 28k extra steps, even in the middle of an 8k dose block. Record actual quotas; do not rebalance or reshuffle.
stage2.alternation_phase: A switch to alternate4k starts with BP phase. Its 28k suffix has 4 BP and 3 DO phases; it is not a same-total-quota contrast with mixture.
stage2.extra_32k_suffix: Not scheduled in this revision. Any extra training or O100 scoring at 32k requires a new pre-outcome specification and separate costs.

directions: switch when score is above threshold
switch when score is below threshold
rule_specification.exact_decision: q is integer; compare 2*q to odd threshold numerator. Equality is impossible.
rule_specification.objective: Maximize equal-parent mean final macro success of selected 28k action; both states per parent have equal weight. Implement as integer total selected O100 successes because all cells have 400 episodes.
tie_breaks: fixed candidate order: keep, switch, high thresholds descending, low thresholds ascending
rule_specification.fallback: No successful selection gate: retain F* and do not claim an adaptive improvement. Missing or invalid diagnostic is a technical failure, not silently imputed.
rule_specification.outer_validation: For each of five parents, fit among the 26 candidates on the other four parents (8 states), then choose and score both held-out states. Aggregate two states within parent, then parents equally.
rule_specification.sensitivity: Remove one parent, rerun threshold fitting and leave-parent-out scoring among the remaining four parents. F*/A* are held fixed; this remains conditional development evaluation.
rule_specification.final_freeze: Only after the stage2 gate passes, fit once on all ten states and freeze rule ID, threshold, direction, source/input hashes before any fresh-parent result.

stage3.parents: fresh originals never used for stage1/2 method or rule selection
stage3.final_research_scoring: same disjoint outcome bank across arms, never returned to the allocator; accounted separately
stage3.scientific_success: Predeclared practical effect and uncertainty criteria on both information comparisons and both full-budget fixed comparisons, on fresh parents. Do not select the weaker control after seeing fresh results.

conditions: diagnostic leaves all learner/optimizer/replay/collector/RNG state unchanged
learner update rule does not depend on the chosen terminal horizon
both action futures begin from the exact same full 8k state
adaptive action and rule/source/diagnostic hashes are committed before either future is trained or any terminal score is inspected
selected 36k policy and common outcome bank are identical to the corresponding constant-action arm
sharing.execution: Run common F*8k, pay D4k once, record adaptive choice, restore same 8k state for F*32k and A*32k; save suffix28k and suffix32k on both futures. Reuse corresponding 36k score for adaptive arm.
sharing.budget_formula: For N fresh parents and R continuation states per parent: 200000*N + 76000*N*R operational/research training+diagnosis, plus at most 200000*N + 800000*N*R research outcome steps.
sharing.interpretation: Counterfactual outcome sharing is valid only after the decision is committed; five logical arms are not five independent policy samples.

pending_before_execution: freeze fresh parent labels and sample size from stage2 variability and target precision
freeze practical-effect and family-of-four uncertainty procedure before new-parent outcomes
validate horizon independence, checkpoint reuse, diagnosis isolation and decision-before-futures integrity

amendment_timing: During first-parent pretraining, before any parent/branch O100 outcome was produced or inspected
feedback_disposition: All proposed corrections adopted; unchanged sample size, learner, F08 block rules and primary objective
